mapper.update: UPDATE mes_painting_craft SET bool_delete_enum = 0, bool_in_approval = #{boolInApproval}, approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, approval_user_id = #{approvalUserId}, approval_time = #{approvalTime}, old_data = NULL, old_id = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(serial_number, '-', -1)), 0) FROM mes_painting_craft WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT mpc.*, p.id AS 'project.id', p.serial_number AS 'project.serialNumber', p.short_name AS 'project.shortName', cu.id AS 'createUser.id', cu.name AS 'createUser.name', au.id AS 'approvalUser', au.name AS 'approvalUser.name' FROM mes_painting_craft mpc LEFT JOIN contract_project p ON p.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND p.id = mpc.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cu.id = mpc.create_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND au.id = mpc.approval_user_id WHERE mpc.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND date_format(mpc.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startDateTime}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(mpc.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endDateTime}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND mpc.project_id = #{projectId}
AND exists(select 1 from mes_painting_craft_detail mpcd WHERE mpcd.bool_delete_enum = 0 and mpcd.painting_craft_id = mpc.id and mpcd.painting_type_enum = #{paintingTypeEnum})
AND exists(select 1 from mes_painting_craft_detail mpcd WHERE mpcd.bool_delete_enum = 0 and mpcd.painting_craft_id = mpc.id and mpcd.paint_brand = #{paintBrand})
AND mpc.project_id IN
#{i}
